rule: Buildings whose listings sit on higher floors than their registry lot has, or whose lot holds no apartments (a school, garage, park or vacant lot), mostly from reverse geocoding StreetEasy's coordinates onto a neighbouring lot, are geocoded from the address on their own building page. Each corrected lot is residential and tall enough for the floors its listings give.
